about: The fewest passing titles scripts/loam-exit-check.mjs --phase 6 --milestone m1 accepts for each of M1's rows (phase 6 specification, 5.3 and section 19), by the place its row names, so an exclude, a skipped suite or a deleted file cannot pass unnoticed. P6-E8 is the check itself and E9's budget has no count.

Each is the count a full run observed. When exit tests are added or removed on purpose, run the check on a run that has them with --phase 6 --milestone m1 --print-minimums, and copy the counts it prints here in the same pull request, saying why each changed.
